description: Accounts in Hebrew script. Dating: perhaps sixteenth century based on the paleography and Ottoman terminology. A name ending in bashī appears in the first entry. This may be some kind of Ottoman rank and/or title: başı / head-[...] in Turkish. The second entry mentions Mūrād Beğ (). Requires further examination. MCD.
